items.name: Harbor Rush
items.hook: Swing a real crane over a stacked ship and dig out what each truck wants. Wind, frozen reefers and a hazmat night shift.

items.name: Heist Planner
items.hook: Draw every crew member's moves on a blueprint timeline, hit play, and watch the heist unfold. Tweak and rerun until it's flawless.

items.name: Food Truck Wars
items.hook: Drive a truck around a living city, pick the hungriest corner for the hour, serve fast, and fight rivals for the best spots.

items.name: Castle Crushers
items.hook: A physics siege puzzle where fire burns wood, ice cracks stone and one perfect shot brings the whole castle down.

items.name: Clockwork Heart
items.hook: Place gears, belts and pulleys so a single crank powers every machine on the board.

items.name: Mirror Vault
items.hook: Bend lasers through mirrors, splitters and prisms. Mix colors, time moving mirrors, crack the safe.

items.name: Gravity Box
items.hook: Tilt a 3D room to roll marbles home, but every tilt moves everything at once.

items.name: Dungeon Drop
items.hook: Five-minute roguelike runs: draft a card every room, break the game with a combo, unlock more each death.

items.name: Merge Kingdom
items.hook: Merge matching pieces into better ones until huts become villages, then castles, then an empire.

items.name: Idle Planet
items.hook: Start with one rock. Automate mining, factories, terraforming and whole solar systems. Earns while you're away.

items.name: One Tap Golf
items.hook: Physics mini-golf on wild procedural courses where one tap sets power and angle.

items.name: Word Forge
items.hook: Swipe letters into words that become weapons. Longer, rarer words hit harder.

items.name: Startup Sim
items.hook: Take a garage idea to IPO and walk away actually understanding pricing, burn, runway, fundraising and cap tables.

items.name: Code Quest
items.hook: Program your dungeon hero with real code. Levels and boss fights teach loops, conditions and functions for real.

items.name: Negotiator
items.hook: Haggle with landlords, contractors, investors and dealers who each hide a breaking point. Learn anchoring and leverage.

items.name: Typing Blitz
items.hook: Type falling words before they hit. A real WPM and accuracy trainer that keeps getting faster.

items.name: Mental Math Arena
items.hook: Speed-math duels with tutorials that teach real tricks until you're a human calculator.

note: Weekly launches on Thursdays at noon ET; during Chanukah a new game launches every day except Shabbos. Each game opens in early access a week before its launch.
